subject: Operations
title: Green Supply Chains
description: A quick, practical guide to Green Supply Chains.

hook.text: Shipping a T-shirt from Asia to America emits more carbon than making it. Supply chains are climate battlegrounds.

buildup.text: Green supply chains minimize environmental impact across sourcing, production, transportation, and disposal.

discovery.text: Strategies include local sourcing, energy-efficient transport, reduced packaging, and circular design.

twist.text: Going green can cost more short-term. But regulations, customer preferences, and carbon taxes are closing the gap.

climax.text: IKEA committed to 100% renewable energy in its supply chain by 2030—turning sustainability into brand value.

punchline.text: Green supply chains are good business, not just good ethics.

quiz.question: What is a green supply chain strategy?
options: Reducing environmental impact across all stages
